name: One Thousand Angle Lantern
description: Dongguan Thousand-angle Lantern, originated from the palace lanterns of the Song Dynasty, is a folk craft treasure that combines traditional hand-making with calligraphy and painting, paper-cutting, embroidery and other art forms. The Dongguan Thousand-Horn Lamp is huge in size and exquisite in craftsmanship. It is embellished with the words "Thousands of Horns, Thousands of Lamps", which means "Thousands of horns and thousands of lanterns make people prosperous". After lighting up the lanterns, thousands of lanterns will shine together, shining like a galaxy, it’s amazing!
